title: Multi-Page Portfolio
prompt: Create a navigation menu with two local page links, an about section, and a skip link to main content.
objective: Link at least two existing page files, mark the primary content, and add a skip-navigation link.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: navigation, semantic structure, relative paths.
hints: Use stable relative paths and make link text descriptive. The skip link should target a unique main-content id.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Use stable relative paths and make link text descriptive. The skip link should target a unique main-content id. Required structural evidence: <nav, href="index.html", href="about.html", id="main-content".

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
